title: Audit finding
description: One concrete bug-candidate or boundary-violation surfaced during /kaizen:audit. The audit report is a JSON array of these (or a markdown rendering of one). Distinct from plugin-self-audit/finding.schema.json (which is about plugin-internal audit checkpoints) — this schema is for the user-facing audit of a project's code under review.

id.description: Stable id within a single audit run: F-001, F-002, ... Used by Boy-Scout-trail records (verify-before-execution.demoted_reason) to reference findings that were demoted.

severity.description: P0 = architectural violation (dependency-direction reversed, domain pollution). P1 = boundary leak. P2 = smell. P3 = cosmetic. Matches the boy-scout-rule + onion-ddd-workflow severity ladder.

title.description: One-line description suitable for the audit report's findings list.

file.description: Project-relative path to the file containing the finding. Use src/foo/bar.rs not absolute paths.

line.description: Optional line number. Required for P0/P1; recommended for P2/P3 when unambiguous.

rule_broken.description: Which rule the finding violates. Cite the canonical source (e.g. 'The One Rule — domain depends on infrastructure', 'DRY — duplicated business logic', 'YAGNI — abstraction with no consumers'). Used by the audit reporter to group findings by principle.

fix_shape.description: One-line remediation suggestion (NOT the full fix). E.g. 'extract UserRepository trait into domain/ports; impl in infrastructure'. The full plan goes into writing-plans/executing-plans output.

candidate_class.description: Classification matches audit/SKILL.md 'Good Candidate Classes' + the onion-ddd-workflow violation matrix. Used by /kaizen:metrics to track distribution.

proof_status.description: proved = failing test or concrete repro exists. unproved = grep / code-read evidence only. speculative = hypothesis. audit/SKILL.md Rule 'No fix without proof' applies — speculative findings should be discarded, not reported.

disposition.description: How the finding was handled during the audit flow. applied = fixed in-flow (per audit Step 7 + boy-scout-rule Rule 5). trailed = filed to backlog/TODO. reported-only = listed in the findings report without action (the default for proved P0/P1 in 'report only' mode).

trail_ref.description: When disposition=trailed: backlog id, TODO marker, or issue url. Mirrors verify-before-execution's trail_ref.

snippet.description: Verbatim 1-5 line excerpt. Long evidence belongs in attached logs, not the finding record.

language.description: Optional syntax hint for rendering (rust, typescript, python, go, etc.).
